title: arXiv papers to read
description: Send arXiv ids or links on arxiv.org. An id with no paper comes back free.

papers.title: Papers
papers.description: arXiv ids (1706.03762, hep-th/9901001) or links on arxiv.org. Versions such as 1706.03762v5 are accepted.

maxPapers.title: Max papers
maxPapers.description: How many papers to read and sell. Default 100, maximum 500.

includeAbstract.title: Include the abstract
includeAbstract.description: Add the full abstract text to every row. On by default.
